type: Read existing source and existing tests to distinguish completed native coverage from remaining real-client scope

observations.finding: Repaired waterwheel block is intentionally world-shared. Another player must independently use it to acknowledge completion, consumes no cable and receives no owner coins. A TCP isolation assertion must check private payment/reward ownership and no unsolicited receipt write, not require the world block to stay unrepaired for the other client.
Six special routes delegate to native secret/dialogue/dance handlers. Giving milk bypasses mortuary/tea secret routes, so a test using milk cannot claim coverage of their current dialogue workflows.

Nine generic sites have actual elapsed-world-tick coverage with disconnected ServerPlayer identities; well/puzzle also have native timer evidence. These do not substitute for real TCP clients or rendered Chinese messages.
Existing45 native listener calls cover6block eye boundary and forged hit locations. They are not packets transmitted over a real TCP socket.
Battlefield progress counts distinct physical anchors and well consumes seven real water deliveries; completion/reward tests must retain these native rules and must not edit start/next times.

remaining_acceptance: 15 live client Chinese messages/screens and actual C2S interactions; private progress/reward ownership plus intentional shared physical repair semantics. Reuse existing natural-placement and timing evidence; do not rebuild scenes.
next_controller_constraints: Two distinct real clients, native inventory and use-item C2S.
Capture client-local resolved Chinese components and actual rendered screens, not only resource JSON.
Compare relevant player private state before and after other client action, including native special receipts.
No arbitrary timer rewrite, grant completed states, manual BlockState.use or direct connection.handleUseItemOn accepted as TCP evidence.
Use verified existing natural-world copy if feasible; label supplied gear and positions.
